abilities.name: Natural Agility
abilities.description: Jump over unpathable terrain or Structures, up to a maximum range.; 25; trait

fields.notes: Natural Agility cannot be used if there is no unpathable terrain between Hanzo and target point, or if there are no viable landing spots in range. Hanzo cannot use Natural Agility to jump over pathing blockers or friendly Gates. Hanzo always lands at 2 range from the edge of the terrain, regardless of its width.

abilities.name: Storm Bow
abilities.description: Activate to charge an arrow that deals 291 damage to the first enemy hit. Storm Bow's range increases the longer it is Channeled.

fields.notes: Storm Bow can be channeled indefinitely, but its range stops increasing after 1.25 seconds. Cooldown starts once Storm Bow is reactivated. Timing a Basic Attack right before Storm Bow ignores the cooldown of the first Basic Attack, which will cause a second Basic Attack to be launched right after Storm Bow is cast.

abilities.name: Scatter Arrow
abilities.description: Fire an arrow that deals 88 to the first enemy Hero hit. Scatter Arrow can collide with terrain and Structures, splitting into 5 arrows that travel extra distance, ricochet up to 4 additional times, and deal 88 damage each to the first enemy hit.

fields.notes: Neither initial projectile nor the ricocheting arrows can ever damage Structures, but only bounce off of them. Hanzo is able to see the collision edges of terrain in 16 radius. Scatter Arrow does not bounce off of pathing blockers or friendly Gates.

abilities.name: Sonic Arrow
abilities.description: Fire an arrow that grants vision in a large area for 5 seconds. Enemies inside are revealed for 1 second. If Sonic Arrow lands directly on an enemy, it deals 165 damage to them and follows them as they move.

abilities.name: Dragonstrike
abilities.description: After 1.5 seconds, summon a pair of Spirit Dragons which travel forward, dealing 84 damage every 0.25 seconds to enemy Heroes in its area. Enemies in the center take 75% increased damage.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Clamping
fields.notes: Interrupting Dragonstrike in its cast period puts the Ability on a 10 second cooldown. Arrow shot at the end of cast animation is purely visual and deals no damage. Center damage bonus stacks additively with offensive damage modifiers that can affect Dragonstrike 's damage.

abilities.name: Dragon's Arrow
abilities.description: Fire a missile that travels across the battleground. Explodes upon hitting an enemy Hero, dealing 130 damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. After traveling a medium distance, the damage is increased to 260 and the Stun duration to 1.25 seconds. After traveling a long distance, the damage is increased to 390 and the Stun duration to 2 seconds.

fields.notes: Distance is measured from the distance traveled rather than the difference from Hanzo's current location. Enemies that are immune to Skillshots cannot be hit by the initial projectile, but can still be affected by the splash, as long as they are not also immune to AoE.

talents.name: Target Practice
talents.description: Quest Hit every enemy Hero with Storm Bow. After hitting every enemy Hero once with Storm Bow, its range is increased by 30%. Reward After hitting every enemy Hero 3 times with Storm Bow, its damage is increased by 100.

fields.notes: Only affects maximum range. Channel time for maximum range remains the same.

_raw_fields: Quest Hit every enemy Hero with Storm Bow. After hitting every enemy Hero once with Storm Bow, its range is increased by 30%. Reward After hitting every enemy Hero 3 times with Storm Bow, its damage is increased by 100.

talents.name: Simple Geometry
talents.description: Quest Hit a Hero with multiple arrows from the same Scatter Arrow cast 20 times. Each arrow hit after the second grants additional progress. Upon hitting terrain for the first time, Scatter Arrow creates 2 additional arrows.
_raw_fields: Quest Hit a Hero with multiple arrows from the same Scatter Arrow cast 20 times. Each arrow hit after the second grants additional progress. Upon hitting terrain for the first time, Scatter Arrow creates 2 additional arrows.

talents.name: Redemption
talents.description: Quest Every 2 Basic Attacks against the same Hero within 10 seconds grants 1 Redemption, stacking up to 12. Dying decreases Redemption by 3, and Redemption can be lost even at maximum stacks. At 12 Redemption, gain 50% Attack Speed.

fields.notes: If there are multiple Hanzos on a team, the attack counter per Hero is shared among all of them and only the one who triggers the second attack on the target gains the stack. While at full stacks attacks do not increment the counter. Attack Speed bonus stacks additively with other effects that can affect Hanzo's Attack Speed.

_raw_fields: Quest Every 2 Basic Attacks against the same Hero within 10 seconds grants 1 Redemption, stacking up to 12. Dying decreases Redemption by 3, and Redemption can be lost even at maximum stacks. At 12 Redemption, gain 50% Attack Speed.

talents.name: Explosive Arrows
talents.description: Upon hitting a Minion or Monster, Storm Bow deals 60% of its damage to enemies around its target.

fields.notes: The splash damage affects all enemies, but is only triggered when Storm Bow hits a Minion or Monster. The splash does not trigger other Talents that interact with Storm Bow, but can benefit from damage increases that affect Hanzo or Storm Bow specifically.

_raw_fields: Upon hitting a Minion or Monster, Storm Bow deals 60% of its damage to enemies around its target.

talents.name: Serrated Arrows
talents.description: Scatter Arrow deals 100% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Scatter Arrow 's damage.

_raw_fields: Scatter Arrow deals 100% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

talents.name: Ignore All Distractions
talents.description: Basic Attacks instantly kill Minions and increase Hanzo's Basic Attack range by 2 for 3 seconds.

fields.notes: Bonus Basic Attack range is only granted or refreshed by Basic Attacking a Minion.

_raw_fields: Basic Attacks instantly kill Minions and increase Hanzo's Basic Attack range by 2 for 3 seconds.

talents.name: The Dragon Hungers
talents.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow grants 5% Spell Power for 12 seconds, stacking up to 20%.

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier, Healing dealt modifier
fields.notes: Spell Power from The Dragon Hungers stacks additively with itself and other sources of Spell Power as well as other offensive damage and healing dealt modifiers affecting Hanzo's Spell Damage or healing output.

_raw_fields: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow grants 5% Spell Power for 12 seconds, stacking up to 20%.

talents.name: Never Outmatched
talents.description: Reduce Scatter Arrow's Mana cost from 50 to 30. Basic Attacks against Heroes lower the cooldown of Scatter Arrow by 3 seconds.
_raw_fields: Reduce Scatter Arrow's Mana cost from 50 to 30. Basic Attacks against Heroes lower the cooldown of Scatter Arrow by 3 seconds.

talents.name: Sharpened Arrowheads
talents.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow or Basic Attacks reduces their Armor by 3 for 3 seconds, up to a maximum reduction of 20 Armor.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with itself but not with other negative Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow or Basic Attacks reduces their Armor by 3 for 3 seconds, up to a maximum reduction of 20 Armor.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with Mounted Movement Speed bonus, but not with other sources of Movement Speed.

fields.props: Attack Modifier Damage bonuses stack additively with other offensive damage modifiers.

talents.name: Play of the Game
talents.description: While in flight or for up to 2 seconds after impacting a target, Dragon's Arrow can be reactivated to teleport to its location and jump backwards. If used after impact, Hanzo shoots arrows that deal 132 damage to each target hit by the impact. Hanzo is Unstoppable during Play of the Game.
